title: Pasting of the orientation-free diagonal section comparison
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient stage $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, $n\geq1$, of [def-pur-conventions], with the specified global field $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be smooth separated finite-type morphisms of pure relative dimensions $d,e\geq0$ between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the small pro-etale constructible exceptional inverse images and derived operations of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Put $\omega_h=Rh^!\Lambda$ and let $c_{v,u}:R(vu)^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru^!Rv^!$ be the conjugate of compact-support composition [thm-sf-comp-composition, def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. Let $\theta_{h,M}:Lh^*M\otimes^L\omega_h\to Rh^!M$ be the specified tensor map [def-pur-co-smoothness]. For composable smooth maps $u,v$ define
$$\sigma_{u,v}=c_{v,u,\Lambda}^{-1}\circ\theta_{u,\omega_v}\circ\mathrm{sym}:\omega_u\otimes^LLu^*\omega_v\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{vu}.$$
For $h=f,g,gf$, write $W_h=\operatorname{dom}(h)\times_{\operatorname{cod}(h)}\operatorname{dom}(h)$, $p_h$ for its first projection, $\Delta_h$ for the diagonal, $C_h=L\Delta_h^*\omega_{p_h}$ [def-pur-section-invariant], and $\alpha_h:C_h\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_h$ for the specified diagonal base-change map [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change].

Put $Q=X\times_ZY$, $W=X\times_ZX$, $a:W\to Q$, $(x_1,x_2)\mapsto(x_1,f(x_2))$, $b:Q\to X$, $(x,y)\mapsto x$, $t=\Delta_{gf}:X\to W$, and $s=(\operatorname{id}_X,f):X\to Q$. These formulas denote the maps induced by the fibre-product universal property [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $at=s$, $ba=p_{gf}$, and the Cartesian base-change maps identify $C_f\cong Lt^*\omega_a$ and $Lf^*C_g\cong Ls^*\omega_b$. Define the section-pasting comparison, using these maps and the monoidal pullback reassociation, by
$$\kappa:C_f\otimes^LLf^*C_g\xrightarrow{\sim}Lt^*(\omega_a\otimes^LLa^*\omega_b)\xrightarrow{Lt^*\sigma_{a,b}}C_{gf}.$$
Then
$$\alpha_{gf}\circ\kappa=\sigma_{f,g}\circ(\alpha_f\otimes Lf^*\alpha_g).$$
The displayed comparisons commute with restriction to source and target open subschemes on which the morphisms restrict.

Here is the precise coordinate comparison. For a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $B$, put $P_r=\mathbf A^r_B\to B$ [def-sbc-affine-space], let $z_r:B\to\mathbf A^r_B$ be its zero section, and put $D_r=Lz_r^*\omega_{P_r}$. Let $q:\mathbf A^{d+e}_B=\mathbf A^d_{\mathbf A^e_B}\to\mathbf A^e_B$. Base change for the square defining $q$ identifies $Lz_{d+e}^*\omega_q$ with $D_d$, while pullback composition identifies $Lz_{d+e}^*Lq^*\omega_{P_e}$ with $D_e$. Define
$$\nu_{d,e}:D_d\otimes^LD_e\xrightarrow{\sim}Lz_{d+e}^*(\omega_q\otimes^LLq^*\omega_{P_e})\xrightarrow{Lz_{d+e}^*\sigma_{q,P_e}}D_{d+e}.$$
On compatible etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] coordinate charts $U\to\mathbf A^d_V$, $V\to\mathbf A^e_T$ for $f,g$, with $U,V,T$ affine open subschemes of $X,Y,Z$, the coordinate differences in the second factors of the diagonal pairs identify $C_f|_U$, $Lf^*C_g|_U$, $C_{gf}|_U$ with $D_d,D_e,D_{d+e}$ over $B=U$. Under these comparisons, $\kappa|_U=\nu_{d,e}$. These are the canonical etale exceptional-pullback comparisons and monoidal pullback comparisons, and use no diagonal orientation or Tate-twist identification.

proof.text: Use the canonical constructions and already proved geometry of [def-pur-diagonal-section-pasting-data], publicly re-exported from the shared data module. No definition body or statement changes. The two open-immersion helper proofs use the direct pullback-map instance rather than broad instance search.

Derive IsNoetherian Z from the finite-type structure morphism aZ, and IsNoetherian Y and X successively from g and f. Specialize coefficients to P.Coefficient using comparedExponent. Apply lem-pur-diagonal-global-equation for Equation. For arbitrary compatible open restrictions, apply lem-pur-diagonal-open-restriction for the seven OpenEquation squares. For each given affine etale chart of that restricted pair, apply lem-pur-diagonal-affine-chart-equation with base structure map w followed by aZ; open immersions are locally finite type and the Noetherian source gives quasi-compactness. Conjunction introduction and universal introduction give ModelStatement and hence Statement. The three new lemmas are independent proper portions of the original twelve-step proof; their canonical maps and edge cases are unchanged.
